IsAllowed.issue: UNIT GAP: the representation moves the gate. Binary float cannot represent 0.70, so `max_hp * 0.70` lands just BELOW the true 70% for some max HP values and the sim refuses an event the game allows. EXECUTED (`py tools/audit/event_probes_b.py gate`), sweeping every (max_hp, hp) pair with max_hp <= 400: 7 disagreements, all in the same direction (sim False / game True) and all at hp exactly 70% of max -- max_hp/hp = 90/63, 170/119, 180/126, 330/231, 340/238, 350/245, 360/252. LIVE and easily reached: an Ironclad starts at 80 max HP and 90 is one Max-HP relic away, so a 90/63 run is ordinary state, and the consequence is that the node the game would serve as an Unrest Site is filtered out of the sim's event pool -- which then shifts every later event pick, not just this one. The shared contract's 'numeric constants are checked against the non-ascension branch' rule makes 0.70m the canonical value; the defect is the arithmetic, not the constant. Note this is the SAME bug class the damage_pipeline N3 record calls out for Shrink x Vulnerable -- decimal-vs-float -- but at an event GATE rather than in the damage pipeline, so it is a separate site and not that record's blast radius.
